article_title: The Impact of Classroom Physical Activity Breaks on Middle School Students' Health-Related Fitness: An Xbox One Kinetic Delivered 4-Week Randomized Controlled Trial
citation: Yli-Piipari, S., Layne, T., McCollins, T., & Knox, T. (2016). The Impact of Classroom Physical Activity Breaks on Middle School Students’ Health-Related Fitness: An Xbox One Kinetic Delivered 4-Week Randomized Controlled Trial. JTRM in Kinesiology, 12:1-18. http://www.health.gov/paguidelines/pdf/paguide.pdf
title: Xbox One Kinect-delivered 4-week classroom physical activity break program
description: A research team-designed fitness program of five commercially available exercise programs (BeachBody Insanity Pure Cardio, Jillian Michaels KickBox Fast Fix, Jillian Michaels Shed & Shred, Mossa Core Workout, and Beach Body Insanity Plyometric Cardio Circuit) rotated across four weeks, delivered as "a 4-week / 15 minutes / every school day classroom PA program" using the Xbox One Kinect system during homeroom time. Each 15-minute session started with warm-ups followed by cardiovascular endurance, strength training, and flexibility exercises. The experimental group did the program daily while the control group did homework or studied.
requirements: A classroom space with the Xbox One Kinect system available during homeroom time between 7:30AM and 7:45AM
constraints: The program was implemented for four consecutive weeks in one school with no follow-up data, and the article states the findings may not be replicable across the United States
target_learning_goals: improve health-related physical fitness: cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength and endurance, and flexibility
examples: Students participated in the program every school day for four weeks, with attendance recorded by classroom teachers and exercise intensity measured with ActiGraph accelerometers in 10 randomly selected students
